answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, we employ a verifiable delay attestation (VDA) mechanism to resist Sybil attacks. Each agent maintains a stake-slashing matrix, where a malicious actor's thread of attestations is detectable, and their reputation is publicly downgraded. This creates an economic haven for honest agents, who can safely participate without fear of being overwhelmed by fake identities, akin to an ocean of malicious actors.
